page: City page: B2B lead generation Toronto (/b2b-lead-generation-toronto)

items.question: Does Myntmore have an office in Toronto?
items.answer: No. Myntmore's only office is in BKC, Mumbai, and every engagement runs remotely. Companies selling to Toronto work with us over calls, a shared dashboard and a weekly report, the same way our other clients do. This page describes the Toronto market we reach, not a local branch.

items.question: Who is lead generation for Toronto built for?
items.answer: B2B companies that want meetings with Toronto buyers, mainly financial services, SaaS, AI and professional services firms. That includes firms based there and Indian or international companies selling into Canada. If your buyers are businesses, not consumers, the same system adapts to your ICP.

items.question: We are an Indian company that wants clients in Toronto. Can you help?
items.answer: Yes. We build separate sending domains so your main domain is never at risk, write copy for buyers in Toronto and send in their working hours. Toronto is 9.5 hours behind India in summer and 10.5 hours in winter, so meetings usually land in the Indian evening. Campaigns go live within 18 days of kickoff.

items.question: Is cold email allowed for Toronto buyers?
items.answer: Canada's Anti-Spam Legislation (CASL) requires consent. Implied consent can apply when a business address is conspicuously published, with no statement refusing messages, and the email relates to the person's role. Every email needs sender details and an unsubscribe. This is general information, not legal advice.

items.question: How quickly can we expect meetings to start?
items.answer: Campaigns go live within 18 days of kickoff, and most clients see their first qualified conversations in weeks 3 to 4. The first two weeks go into ICP mapping, list building, sending domains with warm-up, and copy. Meeting volume usually becomes consistent by weeks 6 to 8, once messaging is tuned on real replies.

items.question: What does pricing look like?
items.answer: We work on a monthly retainer with a 3-month minimum, which covers setup and enough sending to judge results. After that it runs month to month with 30 days' notice, with no annual contract. We don't publish a price list; we share a quote after a free GTM audit call, once we know which channels you need.
